title: OOBE Update Check Ended Without a Result
description: Detects that the Windows quality update page at the end of OOBE started its Windows Update scan but ended without a scan result (oobe_update_page: startWUScanStartedSuccedded, an OobeNDUP stop and no ExpeditedUpdate_getUpdateResults name), on a device that is out of date and allowed to update. In the observed sessions the page ended two minutes after the scan started, on devices more than a year behind. The device finishes OOBE without the monthly security update. The agent's names_capped marker vetoes the finding: once the page's event names were capped, a missing scan result proves nothing.
explanation: The Windows quality update page at the end of OOBE started a Windows Update scan, but no scan result arrived before the page ended. The device is {{days_out_of_date}} days out of date, so an update was due — the device finished OOBE without the monthly security update and installs it only later, through the Windows Update policy that applies after enrollment. The page waits only a short time for the scan (two minutes in the observed sessions): a scan that takes longer, or cannot reach Windows Update, ends the page without an update.

remediation.title: Check the path to Windows Update during OOBE
steps: Verify that devices in OOBE reach the Windows Update service: proxy, TLS inspection and firewall rules for the Windows Update endpoints.
Check whether an update policy applied during the Enrollment Status Page points the scan at another source, such as WSUS.

remediation.title: Shorten the scan
steps: Devices far behind scan longer; a current OS image or factory build keeps the OOBE scan short.
Verify the device's patch level after enrollment; the update ring assigned to the device installs the missing monthly security update on its normal schedule.
